title: The Mystery of the Missing Key
passage: Leo stared at the empty hook by the front door. The silver key to the community garden was gone. He had promised his neighbor, Ms. Gable, that he would water her prize-winning tomatoes while she was away. He remembered having the key when he came home from school because he had accidentally dropped his heavy backpack on his toes right in the hallway. Now, the key had vanished. Leo retraced his steps. He checked the kitchen counter, but only saw a bowl of fruit. He checked the couch cushions, finding only a stray nickel. Just as he was about to give up, he noticed his dog, Buster, wagging his tail near the hallway rug. Under the corner of the rug, which was slightly turned up, Leo saw a glint of silver. He realized that when he dropped his heavy bag earlier, the force must have knocked the key off the hook and sent it sliding across the hardwood floor and under the rug.
